purpose: Prove an ordinary two-source goal can automatically expand a repeated verified provider into distinct aliased instances, wire both producer results into one list-valued consumer input, execute the resulting deterministic graph, and independently verify source multiplicity and the terminal artifact without mission-authored graph or valueflow.
goal: Assess the knowledge consistency of the observations available from https://httpbin.org/get?claim=alpha and https://httpbin.org/anything?claim=beta.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime')
mission=json.loads((root/'missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_AUTO_FANIN_CAPABILITY_PROPOSAL_001.json').read_text())
step=mission['steps'][0]
for forbidden in ('required_target_effects','semantic_goal_proposals','capability_problem_proposal','controller_actions'):
    assert forbidden not in step, forbidden
state=json.loads((root/'state/ASTRA-RUNTIME-AUTO-FANIN-CAPABILITY-PROPOSAL-001.json').read_text())
result=state['history'][0]['result']
semantic=result['semantic_goal_contract']
generation=result['proposal_generation']
assert semantic['status']=='QUORUM_VERIFIED', semantic
assert semantic['target_effects']==['knowledge.assessment.available'], semantic
assert set(semantic['generated_authorities'])=={'registry-effect-lexical-v1','compiler-score-v1'}, semantic
assert generation['generator']=='multi-verified-capability-v1', generation
assert generation['capability_plan']==['knowledge.json.fetch.external','knowledge.consistency.assess'], generation
expanded=generation['expanded_instance_plan']
assert expanded==[
  'auto-knowledge-json-fetch-external-1',
  'auto-knowledge-json-fetch-external-2',
  'auto-knowledge-consistency-assess',
], expanded
fanin=generation['fan_in']['knowledge.json.fetch.external']['knowledge.observation.available']
assert fanin==[
  'knowledge.observation.available.fanin.1',
  'knowledge.observation.available.fanin.2',
], fanin
binding=generation['bindings']['auto-knowledge-consistency-assess']['evidence_paths']
assert binding['bound_effects']==fanin, binding
assert len(binding['providers'])==2 and len(set(binding['providers']))==2, binding
runtime_plan=result['capability_plan']['plan']
assert runtime_plan==expanded, runtime_plan
assessment_path=generation['bindings']['auto-knowledge-consistency-assess']['output_path']['value']
assessment=json.loads(pathlib.Path(assessment_path).read_text())
assert assessment['schema']=='PROJECT_BRAIN_KNOWLEDGE_ASSESSMENT_V1', assessment
assert assessment['evidence_count']==2, assessment
assert assessment['fresh_evidence_count']==2, assessment
assert assessment['distinct_fresh_source_identities']==2, assessment
assert assessment['status']=='CONFLICTED', assessment
assert assessment['invalid']==[], assessment
print('AUTO_FANIN_CAPABILITY_PROPOSAL_INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED')
PY
